text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. ……sorry for taking so long. 
About my next race――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to take first place in the 『NHK
Mile Cup』! 
I look forward to your guidance!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I thought there was something that I
could show them, 
that these legs could leave behind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Since Trainer-san and everyone else believes
in my speed…… 
I will definitely win the title of
『Generation's Fastest』!

Yeah. ……『Strong Uma Musume are Strong』. 
You'll prove that in your own way,
in a way that only you can!

Yeah. ……『Strong Uma Musume are Strong』. 
You'll prove that in your own way,
in a way that only you can!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……I see. So you've decided too. 
……Alright, now that we've decided that,
time's running out!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Something that nobody has achieved before.
Obtaining the 
unorthodox double crown of the 『Oka Sho』
and 『NHK Mile C』. 
We need to make sure to train and prepare
properly!
And with that said――!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah~, so we're doing training camp here,
huh!? Ufufu,
being completely surrounded by the forest 
like this,
I'll be able to sleep reeeeally well~.

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Idiot! You're an idiot!
We're here for training camp, you know!?
Especially for those two in the Classic 
class!
They need to really train up after all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, King-san,
thank you for the wonderful 
suggestion!
I'm going to put my luggage away and 
get changed, okay? Let's get started soon!

And so, surrounded by forests, mountains, 
and nature,
the days of intense training began……!

Kraft! There's a steep hill nearby.
It might be a good 
place to work on dashing.
Want to go check it out later?

Kraft! There's a steep hill nearby.
It might be a good 
place to work on dashing.
Want to go check it out later?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah……! Thank you very much! 
Please add it to the menu!

And, Cesario.
In preparation for the 『Oaks』 
we're going to focusing on stamina
training.

And, Cesario.
In preparation for the 『Oaks』 
we're going to focusing on stamina
training.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I understand. 
By all means,
thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Uhii-, the classic crew has it rough……!! 
But, seeing them work so hard nearby,
gets me motivated!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I guess it makes you think you should work
hard too…… 
Nnnnnnaa~~, I guess we should do another lap,
huh!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu……isn't this fine? 
Looks like this training camp will be
worthwhile!

We worked hard from early in the morning
until sunset. 
The Classic class was working hard to prepare
for this once-in-a-lifetime event,
so they wouldn't have any regrets.
And then, after all that hard training――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fuuuu……the fire for this grill has also been
lit. It's ready to 
be used so go ahead and arrange the vegetables
as you like.

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Amazing~……You really are reliable and 
efficient when your switch is on,
Cesario……!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah……but, Cesario,
are you properly eating too? 
You don't have to keep looking after all of
us you know~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
They're right, Cesario-san. 
Nutrition is quite important for building
up your body after all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
That big carrot wrapped in foil that we 
grilled is almost ready isn't it?
I'll go get it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. But, I'll go cut it,
so do you want to 
split it? Kraft,
you'd probably burn yourself after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!?
Aren't you treating me too much like a kid!?
C'mon-……!

Heeey,
everyone!
I bought a bunch of apples for dessert. 
Think it's about time I started peeling
them?

Heeey,
everyone!
I bought a bunch of apples for dessert. 
Think it's about time I started peeling
them?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, how thoughtful!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer……are you gonna be okay? 
It'd be bad if you cut yourself,
should I peel them instead?
choice_data_list: Huh? Now I'm treated like a kid too!?
Huh? Now I'm treated like a kid too!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! 
Trainer-san, you're just like me now, huh?

The team's cheerful laughter filled the
air. 
After exhausting themselves with intense
training, 
it was time to replenish those lost
nutrients――

And then tomorrow,
they'd resume their intense 
training,
aiming for victory. And that's how 
they spent the rest of training camp――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaa, I'm exhausted today too~……! 
I guess the training camp is coming to an
end soon, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah……but I do feel like I've made good
progress towards the 
『Oaks』.
It feels like my stamina has improved quite
a lot.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
Since I've been working on improving my 
dash strength,
I feel like my starts are getting 
much smoother and I'm able to pull ahead
easier.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah――It's good. I feel the difference.
I think I'm 
all set,
in regards to winning at the 『NHK Mile C』!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……I wonder if there's anyone watching me.
If I'll be able to…… 
leave something behind.
……I want to leave something behind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Hey,
you know how they say 『It kind of feels like
fate』?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah……do you think it's something unique to
Uma Musume? But, I know what you mean.
I can't really put it in 
words though……kind of like how I feel with
Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right! Kind of like some mysterious force
pulling on you……or leading you.
Like when you're with 
them,
you feel this warm light in your chest.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To become that 『Something』 for someone.
That's what I want too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To have someone feel that kind of fate
with 
you……huh. You're right, that dream you've 
always been talking about is a bit like
that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
If my running can make someone feel some
kind of fate……
if my aspiration becomes that link for someone,
it would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……Cesario. 
I'm going to win the 『NHK Mile C』

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……Yeah. 
Someone will definitely be watching you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
……Alright,
we have an early morning tomorrow so we
should get to 
bed. Let's get a good rest and work hard
again tomorrow, Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Good night, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I'll keep doing my best,
and run. So I can leave something 
behind.
……I'll definitely leave something behind)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (My heritage, without a doubt)
